Q8537.reason: A value-neutral definition keeps moral justification out of the concept so the question whether punishment is justified stays open.

Q6097.reason: Most states treat a fee tail as a fee simple, so the cousin took the whole estate and the later deed to the niece conveys nothing.

Q8324.reason: Chronic synaptic dopamine flooding leads the postsynaptic neuron to reduce its receptors, so ordinary dopamine no longer satisfies and the patient is driven to seek more drug.
